schemeName: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST)
description: Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe scholars pursuing regular and full-time M.Phil and Ph.D. courses in Indian Universities and Institutes.
selectionMethodDescription: Merit-based ranking based on postgraduate percentage, with statutory preference for PVTG and Divyangan candidates.

requiredDocuments.label: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Caste Certificate
requiredDocuments.helpText: Government issued ST certificate from a competent revenue authority.

requiredDocuments.label: Postgraduate Degree Final Marksheet / Degree
requiredDocuments.helpText: Official university transcript verifying postgraduate percentage marks.

quotaRules.notes: Statutory priority queue for PVTG candidates and 5% horizontal reservation for Divyangan.

schemeName: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Candidates (NOS)
description: Financial assistance for meritorious ST students to pursue Master's level courses, Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral research programmes abroad.
selectionMethodDescription: Selection through Screening Committee evaluation followed by an Interview by the Selection Committee.

requiredDocuments.label: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Caste Certificate
requiredDocuments.helpText: Government issued ST certificate from competent authority.

requiredDocuments.label: Qualifying Degree Marksheet / Degree Transcript
requiredDocuments.helpText: Transcript verifying minimum 60% marks in qualifying degree.

requiredDocuments.label: Admission Intent Proof / Offer Letter from Accredited Foreign University
requiredDocuments.helpText: Unconditional offer letter or confirmed admission proof from an accredited institution abroad.

requiredDocuments.label: Family Income Certificate (Revenue Authority)
requiredDocuments.helpText: Competent authority certificate proving total family income ≤ ₹6,00,000/annum.

quotaRules.notes: Merit and interview selected ST scholars.
3 earmarked seats exclusively reserved for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
